profile: Cytokinetics discovers, develops and commercializes medicines that modulate muscle function for diseases involving impaired muscle performance. Its first commercial product, MYQORZO (aficamten), is a tablet approved for adults with obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. The company’s research focuses on muscle biology and includes investigational small-molecule candidates at discovery, preclinical and clinical stages. Its medicines and development programs address cardiovascular and neuromuscular diseases.
